programme.title: RAILROAD TIGERS [English Dub]

programme.title: Marui Video [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The video evidence of the murder, which is especially brutal and graphic, that shouldn't be released to the public; a reporter who has access to the prosecutor's office hears about a cursed tape in the video archive and begins reporting on it.

programme.title: SAKURAN [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]

There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: House of Wolves [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Charlie is a swindler who pretends to be an ALS patient, while Fung Yan Bing is an idle village leader. These two self-proclaimed wicked men fall in love at first sight with Yu Chun, a newcomer to the village. Chun arrives at the village after falling out with her ex-boyfriend and is pregnant with their child. While helpless, Chun devises a scheme where she invites both to her house for dinner, causing them to be drunk and mistakenly believing that one of them has impregnated her.

programme.title: On Your Wedding Day [English Subtitle]

While she doesn’t even remember him, Woo-jin is happy that she’s by his side again. As Woo-jin tells Soo-ah about their love story, the two lovers fall in love with each other all over again.

programme.title: War Of The Arrows [English Dub]
programme.desc: Korean archer Nam-Yi risks all to save his sister from Manchurian soldiers in Qing Dynasty raids. Epic action ensues.

programme.title: Airpocalypse [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Cadaver [English Sub]
programme.desc: Seon-hwa is a new student at an elite medical school, and she is initiated into a dissection class headed by Dr. Han along with five other students, including her boyfriend Ki-beom. After the first class the students all start to share the same nightmare involving a one-eyed surgeon, and one by one they start to be murdered, the victims being discovered with their hearts removed. Seon-hwa and Ki-beom are convinced that these events are related to a beautiful cadaver with a rose tattoo on her breast, and they begin an investigation to uncover her identity.

programme.title: Silence of Smoke [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning director of "Departures", Yojiro Takita. When a father refuses to reveal the family recipe for a renowned generational cake, his son decides to carve his own path in life, not realizing a deep secret hidden for his own good.

programme.desc: In this epic true story inspired by the legend of King Gesar, a young man grows up in exile in a world overrun by demons and monsters. When evil forces threaten his home, he returns to save his people and embrace his destiny as great hero and ruler.

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]

programme.title: Midnight [English Dub]
programme.desc: The witness who is unable to hear, becomes the serial killer's next target! 'Kyung-mi' who is deaf, was on the way home when she witnessed 'So-jung' bleeding out on the road.
